Мы выражаем наши глубочайшие соболезнования премьер-министру @takaichi_sanae и народу Японии. Желаю скорейшего выздоровления всем, кто получил ранения, и сил всем пострадавшим общинам.
items.original_title: Any loss of human life is heartbreaking, especially when it is taken by war or a natural disaster. In Ukraine, we are closely following the reports about the earthquake in Japan. We extend our deepest condolences to Prime Minister @takaichi_sanae and to the people of Japan. Wishing a swift recovery to everyone who was injured and strength to all the affected communities.
